content:
**Ridge Trout** is a type of fish in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Gone Fission* update. 

A generic fish that can be caught with Bait - Common. When eaten, it gives two Rads and restores a total of 20 Hit Points over 25 seconds. It can alternatively be sold, displayed on a Curved Fish Display or Fish Display Plaque, or cooked into Fish Bits.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Ridge Trout (1) | | **Built or Scrapped:** | | Fish Bits (2) | 

Can be caught from any fishing spot across all Regions of Appalachia.
